mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 4% in the month preceding the prediction is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when FEDFUNDS > 4%, or inflation-adjusted returns remain positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 5.5% for two consecutive months coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower labor market participation reduces risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE meeting the trigger, or the effect persists only in contractionary periods.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 (real GDP) exceeds INDPRO by more than 5% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is positive, reflecting stronger demand-driven growth momentum.
regime_hint: Economic expansion with strong demand relative to production
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant when the trigger is met, or the effect reverses in the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of at least 8% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as supply contraction raises uncertainty.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO meeting the trigger, or the effect is absent in non-crisis periods.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for three consecutive months in a non-recession regime, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is positive, reflecting lower policy-driven discounting.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive over the 3-month low-rate window, or the effect is only observed during recessions.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS below 140,000 in a month coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market weakness signals risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not negative when PAYEMS drops below threshold, or the effect is absent in strong labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS > 400 billion and HOUST > 1100 indicate strong industrial and consumer demand, predicting a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: Double-digit growth in industrial and consumer activity
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both triggers persist, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 236 (current level) by more than 2% in the following month predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of higher inflation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >2% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when CPIAUCSL meets the trigger, or the effect is only seen in transitory shocks.
